# Beast Lore Plus

**Know what a beast will teach you before you tame it.** A hunter addon for **World of Warcraft Forever**.

Cast **Beast Lore** on a tameable beast as usual. Under the game's own lines (Tameable,
Specialization, Diet) Beast Lore Plus adds a **Pet Abilities** section: every ability that beast
teaches, with its rank and a dot that says whether you need it.

## Features

- **Enhanced Beast Lore.** Every ability and rank the beast teaches, with a status dot.
  Beasts with no known abilities say "No known abilities", with a hint to tame one and help
  confirm until 2 different hunters have confirmed it teaches nothing. Nothing is added for beasts
  that cannot be tamed.
- **Learned-ability tracking per character.** Open Beast Training once and the addon remembers which
  abilities and ranks that hunter knows. It updates whenever Beast Training opens or you learn a rank.
- **Ability Finder** (`/blp` or the minimap button). Pick any pet ability and rank to see which
  beasts teach it, with level range, zone and your status. Search, sort by level/name/zone, filter
  by zone (nearest first), and set a **Level** with **Can learn now** (hide beasts above that level) and
  **Already learned** (show ranks you know). Click a beast to drop a **map pin** where it spawns (plus a
  **TomTom** arrow if you use TomTom; exact spawns need Questie installed). The **Pet** button shows only
  the abilities one pet family can learn ("My pet" follows the pet you have out).
- **Community confirmation.** When you tame a beast, the abilities your new pet arrived with are
  recorded and shared with other Beast Lore Plus users (guild + a hidden channel), so the data gets
  better over time. See below.
- **Options** (Esc › Options › AddOns › Beast Lore Plus, or `/blp options`): minimap button,
  community sharing, showing details without casting Beast Lore (off by default; when on, hovering
  a beast shows its remembered Beast Lore lines, or its family's Specialization and Diet, and Pet Abilities), grey "?" rows, and NPC IDs (debug).

Non-hunters can still open the Finder; it just has no status column.

## Legend

| Dot | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 🟢 Green | You already know this rank |
| 🟡 Yellow | You have a higher rank, but not this one (learning a higher rank does not teach the lower ones) |
| 🟠 Orange | You know a lower rank — taming this beast is an **upgrade** |
| 🔴 Red | You have not learned this ability at all |
| ⚪ Grey "?" | Unknown — open **Beast Training** once on this character |

Entries tagged *unverified* come from a single source, or sources disagree. They still show, so you
can check them in game.

Beast Training only lists the abilities your current pet's family can use, so a skipped lower rank
turns yellow only after Beast Training has shown that ability once; until then it stays green.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/blp` or `/beastloreplus` | Open the Ability Finder |
| `/blp options` | Open the options |
| `/blp minimap` | Show or hide the minimap button |
| `/blp export` | Copy your captured tames and data conflicts, ready for a GitHub issue |
| `/blp capture` | Record the pet you have out (target a wild beast of the same kind first) |
| `/blp debug` | Show the target's NPC ID, the last Beast Lore lines and your Beast Training scan |

## Help improve the data

The bundled database was built from public sources (Petopia, Wowhead, warcraft.wiki.gg, Warcraft
Tavern and others), with every entry needing two independent sources to count as confirmed. Forever
changed hunter pets (new families, new family abilities, new beasts), so some entries are still
unverified or missing. You can help:

1. **Just tame beasts.** Your capture is shared automatically (you can turn sharing off in the
   options). A beast missing from the database is filled in for everyone once **3 different hunters**
   report the same abilities ("community: pending 1/3" until then). Community reports never
   overwrite the bundled data.
2. **Send an export.** Type `/blp export`, copy the text, and paste it into a
   [new GitHub issue](https://github.com/TankerALane/beastloreplus/issues/new). Each release folds
   confirmed reports into the bundled data.

Shared messages contain only the beast's NPC ID and name, the abilities and ranks, your client build
and the addon version. When you cast Beast Lore, its Specialization and Diet lines (with the NPC ID
and creature family) are shared the same way, so "details without casting" can show them for
everyone; shared lines are used once 2 different hunters agree.

## Support

support@decoupledlane.com · [Issues](https://github.com/TankerALane/beastloreplus/issues)

---

### For developers

- Data: raw research lives in `tools/data/raw/*.json`, and tames verified in game (from `/blp export`
  issues) go in `tools/data/ingame_tames.json` (source `in-game`, most trusted). `python tools/build_data.py` generates
  `Data/Abilities.lua`, `Data/Beasts.lua` and `tools/data/REVIEW.md`. Never edit the generated Lua.
- Tests: `luajit tests/run_tests.lua`. Lint: `luajit tools/lint.lua` (luacheck via its Lua API).
- Local install: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\install_local.ps1` (add `-Junction`
  to link instead of copy).
- Releases: pushing a `v*` tag runs the BigWigs packager (CurseForge project 1822393).

# Changelog

## 1.0.3 (2026-11-21)

- Fix: with "Show Beast Lore details without casting Beast Lore" on, the tooltip no longer flickers or
  jumps on mouseover; the lines are added at once instead of a frame later.
- Specialization / Diet added on mouseover: label in yellow, value in white.
- Ability Finder: **Pet** family filter. Pick a family (or "My pet", which follows the pet you have out)
  to see only the abilities it can learn. Family lists are from two agreeing sources
  (`tools/data/families.json`); Cower and trainer abilities count for every family.
- Ability Finder: the legend shows the yellow dot (higher rank known, this one not).
- Ability Finder: a "Learned by" line under the heading lists the pet families that can learn the
  selected ability.
- Data: Swoop (Claw 1) and Ghostpaw Alpha (Bite 4, Furious Howl 2) confirmed in game; Beast Lore lines
  bundled for Bear and more beasts.

## 1.0.2 (2026-11-21)

- Data: in-game tames are now the complete ability list for that beast. Prairie Wolf Alpha teaches only
  Bite 2 (no Furious Howl); Hecklefang Stalker and Sunscale Lashtail teach nothing; Fleeting
  Plainstrider (Cower 1, Dust Cloud 1), Washte Pawne (Lightning Breath 3), Silithid Creeper, Ornery
  Plainstrider and Greater Thunderhawk confirmed in game. Beasts that teach nothing say "No known
  abilities" without the "Tame it to help confirm!" hint.
- Bundled Specialization / Diet for Carrion Bird, Cat, Tallstrider, Wind Serpent and Wolf.
- Ranks are tracked one by one: learning a higher rank does not teach the lower ones. A lower rank you
  don't have shows a new **yellow** dot ("you have a higher rank, but not this one"). Beast Training only
  lists the current pet family's abilities, so this applies once Beast Training has listed that ability;
  until then lower ranks stay green. Green now means "you know this rank".
- Option **Show Beast Lore details without casting Beast Lore** (off by default). When on, hovering a
  beast shows the Beast Lore lines seen the last time you cast Beast Lore on it (Tameable,
  Specialization, Diet), or "Tameable" for beasts in the database, followed by Pet Abilities.
  Specialization and Diet are remembered per creature family, so a beast you never lored shows those
  of its family once you have cast Beast Lore on any beast of that family.
- Specialization and Diet come from three places: your own Beast Lore casts, the bundled
  `Data/Lore.lua` (lines seen in game, added each release), and other Beast Lore Plus users, who share
  what their Beast Lore casts show (used once 2 different hunters agree). Shown in Blizzard's default
  tooltip yellow. Beasts known to be untameable say "Cannot Be Tamed".
- `/blp export` lists the Specialization and Diet seen for each family and each beast.
- Fix: when the game's "You have learned a new spell" message has no rank (Forever sends
  "[Lightning Breath]" for Rank 2), the rank now comes from your pet instead of assuming Rank 1, so the
  dot no longer shows orange until you open Beast Training.

## 1.0.1 (2026-11-21)

- Data: entries where a beast would teach a higher rank than its level allows (below every teacher
  of the rank before) are removed, e.g. Savannah Patriarch as Cower (Rank 4).
- Ability Finder: **Level** box (defaults to your level) with **Can learn now** (hide beasts above the
  level) and **Already learned** (show ranks you know), replacing "Only upgrades for me". Beasts above
  the level are dimmed when shown.
- Ability Finder: click a beast to set a map pin where it spawns, plus a TomTom arrow when TomTom is
  installed. Spawn points come from Questie's database when Questie is installed, otherwise from where
  you last targeted that beast; with neither, the world map opens on its zone.
- Ability Finder: the list no longer looks empty after a filter shortens it while scrolled down.
- Ability Finder: the search box placeholder fits the box (full hint on mouse-over).
- Ability Finder: results are grouped under a header per ability and rank (icon, pet level, TP,
  beast count), with a gap between groups; click a header to show only that rank.
- Ability Finder: rank buttons you already know are greyed out.
- Ability Finder: rank buttons only appear for ranks with beasts under the current filters (e.g.
  "Can learn now" at level 27 hides Claw 5), and abilities with nothing to show are dimmed.
- Ability Finder: sorts **nearest first** by default (Zone column; click again for farthest), the zone
  menu lists zones nearest first, the active sort column shows an arrow, and the sort is remembered.
- Ability Finder: typing a search shrinks the ability list to matching abilities; level, toggles and
  zone only grey abilities out.

## 1.0.0 (2026-11-21)

First release for WoW Forever (1.60.1).

- Beast Lore shows a **Pet Abilities** section: each ability and rank the beast teaches, with a
  green / orange / red / grey status dot for this hunter. Abilities that an in-game tame confirmed
  are tagged "confirmed in game". Beasts with no known abilities say so, with a hint to tame one
  until two hunters have confirmed it.
- Per-character learned-ability tracking from Beast Training (Forever's pet trainer window, including
  the new family abilities) and from "You have learned a new spell" messages, so Beast Training only
  needs opening once per character.
- **Ability Finder** window: search, rank filter, zone filter, sort, "Only upgrades for me".
- Minimap button (LibDBIcon) and options panel.
- **Community confirmation:** fresh tames are recorded and shared (guild + hidden channel); gaps are
  filled after 3 different hunters agree; disagreements with bundled data are kept as conflicts.
- `/blp export` (tames, conflicts, gap reports and confirmations, ready for a GitHub issue),
  `/blp capture` (record the pet you have out), `/blp debug`.
- Bundled database: 32 pet abilities (including Forever's family abilities such as Savage Rend,
  Tendon Rip, Pinch and Web) and 436 beasts, with confirmed / unverified tags.
